reads.text: KNOW A TEACHER WHO DESERVES RECOGNITION? NOMINATE THEM FOR THE Z93 TEACHER OF THE MONTH AWARD AT Z93 HITS DOT COM. EACH MONTH WE’LL CHOOSE A WINNER, HIGHLIGHT THEM ON THE AIR AND AWARD THEM WITH A PRIZE PACKAGE. WE’LL ANNOUNCE A WINNER ON THE THIRD THURSDAY OF EACH MONTH.

reads.name: 90s, 2K & Today Dance Party
reads.text: This Saturday, downtown Traverse City turns into one big dance floor! Z93 is teaming up with North Bar and The Pub, and one cover gets you into both. At The Pub, DJ Vi is throwing a '90s Dance Party, so bring your best Macarena. Up at North Bar, I'm spinning Y2K Till Today, everything from the 2000s right up to now. Two great bars, one price, and you can bounce back and forth all night. Grab your crew, come dance, and say hi. Saturday night, downtown TC, presented by Z93!
